description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers deck/slides/presentation/pitch builds in HTML. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: canvas-design (posters/static art), fe-design (responsive UI), design-variations (options), PowerPoint-file requests, and content-only outline asks.
